interpretation.fid: Original RAFM-Ang A has lowest FID for all three seeds. B is substantially worse; C has high seed variance. t-Flow is worse than A on FID.
interpretation.kid: t-Flow mean KID 0.0902553 is lower than A 0.0957694; do not claim all image metrics favor A. This is a descriptive three-seed comparison, not a significance result.
interpretation.b: B has recall 0 for all three seeds, despite finite metrics/samples.
interpretation.c: C seed1234 FID323.1638 drives the large across-seed SD.
interpretation.tflow_radial: t-Flow latent radial W1 405.5948 ±66.3700 and KS0.673867 ±0.089583 show a large radial discrepancy despite finite samples.
interpretation.nested_method_metadata: The shared evaluator emits method=tflow even for ABC. Identify runs using top-level method plus arm; all 12 identities were checked.
